speak volumes: The way he quietly cleaned up after the party without being asked speaks volumes about his character.
他在派對後不用人要求就默默收拾，這一點就充分說明了他的人品，意義重大。
speak one's mind: Our teacher encourages us to speak our minds in class, even when our opinions are different from hers.
我們的老師鼓勵我們在課堂上直言不諱，即使我們的意見和她不同也沒關係。
speak for itself: You don't need to tell everyone how hard you worked; your excellent test score speaks for itself.
你不必告訴大家你多努力，你優異的考試成績就不言自明了。
speak out against: Many students decided to speak out against the new rule because they thought it was unfair.
許多學生決定公開反對新規定，因為他們認為那不公平。
speak up: Please speak up a little, because the students in the back row cannot hear you clearly.
請大聲說一點，因為後排的學生聽不清楚你的聲音。
speak ill of: My grandmother always told us never to speak ill of others when they are not around.
我奶奶總是告訴我們，別人不在場的時候絕對不要說他們的壞話。
actions speak louder than words: He keeps promising to help, but actions speak louder than words, so I will wait and see.
他一直承諾要幫忙，但行動勝於空談，所以我會拭目以待。
spearhead a campaign: A group of high school students decided to spearhead a campaign to reduce plastic waste in their city.
一群高中生決定帶頭發起運動，減少他們城市的塑膠垃圾。
spearhead the attack: The young striker was chosen to spearhead the attack in the final match against the strongest team.
這位年輕前鋒被選中在對上最強隊伍的決賽中率先進攻。
spearhead reforms: The new principal promised to spearhead reforms that would give students more choices in their classes.
新校長承諾主導改革，讓學生在課程上有更多選擇。
specialize in law: After college, my cousin plans to specialize in law because she wants to protect workers' rights.
大學畢業後，我表姊打算專攻法律，因為她想保護勞工的權益。
specialize in seafood: The small restaurants near the harbor specialize in seafood, so the fish there is always fresh.
港口附近的小餐廳專賣海鮮，所以那裡的魚總是很新鮮。
a specialized field: Brain surgery is a specialized field, so doctors need many extra years of training before they practice it.
腦部手術是一個專門領域，所以醫生在執業前需要多年額外的訓練。
specify the date: The invitation did not specify the date of the party, so I had to call my friend to ask.
邀請函沒有指定派對的日期，所以我必須打電話問我朋友。
specify requirements: Before the designer starts, the customer should specify requirements such as size, color, and budget.
在設計師開始之前，客戶應該明確說明需求，例如尺寸、顏色和預算。
unless otherwise specified: All homework must be handed in on Friday unless otherwise specified by your teacher.
除非老師另有說明，所有作業都必須在星期五繳交。
specify in writing: The landlord agreed to specify in writing that we could keep a small pet in the apartment.
房東同意以書面載明我們可以在公寓裡養一隻小寵物。
speculate about the future: It is fun to speculate about the future, but nobody really knows what life will be like in fifty years.
揣測未來很有趣，但沒有人真的知道五十年後的生活會是什麼樣子。
speculate in stocks: My uncle lost most of his savings when he tried to speculate in stocks without enough knowledge.
我叔叔在沒有足夠知識的情況下試圖炒股，結果賠掉了大部分的積蓄。
speculate on the cause: Without clear evidence, the police could only speculate on the cause of the fire in the old factory.
在沒有明確證據的情況下，警方只能猜測那座舊工廠火災的原因。
speculate in property: Some rich investors speculate in property, buying many apartments and selling them when prices go up.
有些富有的投資客炒房，買下許多公寓，等房價上漲時再賣掉。
spell trouble: Dark clouds over the mountains often spell trouble for hikers who have not brought rain gear.
山上的烏雲常常意味著麻煩，對沒帶雨具的登山客來說尤其如此。
spell disaster: Building houses so close to the river could spell disaster if a big typhoon brings heavy rain.
把房子蓋得離河那麼近，如果大颱風帶來豪雨，可能會招致災難。
spell out the details: Before the trip, our teacher will spell out the details, including the schedule and what to bring.
出發前，我們老師會詳細說明細節，包括行程和要帶的東西。
spell the end of: The opening of a huge shopping mall may spell the end of many small family shops in town.
一座大型購物中心的開幕可能意味著鎮上許多家庭小店的結束。
under a spell: When she started singing, the whole audience sat silently, as if they were under a spell.
當她開始唱歌時，全場觀眾安靜地坐著，彷彿著魔了一般。
spend time: I try to spend time with my grandparents every weekend because they feel lonely living by themselves.
我每個週末都盡量花時間陪我的祖父母，因為他們獨自生活覺得很寂寞。
spend energy: Don't spend energy worrying about things you cannot change; focus on what you can do instead.
不要耗費精力擔心你無法改變的事，反而應該專注於你能做的事。
spend the night: The storm was so heavy that we decided to spend the night at a small hotel near the station.
暴風雨太大了，所以我們決定在車站附近的一間小旅館過夜。
spend a fortune: My brother always says he will spend a fortune on a new gaming computer, but he never saves money.
我哥哥總說他要花大錢買一台新電競電腦，但他從來不存錢。
spend wisely: Since our class budget is small, we must spend wisely and buy only what we really need.
因為我們班的預算很少，我們必須明智花錢，只買真正需要的東西。
spent force: The once-famous band is now a spent force, and few young people have even heard of them.
這個曾經很有名的樂團如今已是強弩之末，很少年輕人聽過他們。
